# Code of Conduct

This project welcomes anyone who wants to help build it. Expectations are simple:

- Be respectful and constructive in technical discussions.
- Disagree with ideas, not people. Critique the work, not the contributor.
- Assume good faith. If something reads as hostile, ask before escalating.
- Keep contributions focused on the project. Off-topic personal, political, or ideological content does not belong in issues, PRs, or discussions.
- No harassment, no personal attacks, no doxxing, no spam.

Report violations to dev@reachrobin.com. Reports are read promptly; serious or repeated violations result in removal.

Maintainers have final say on what falls inside or outside these expectations. The goal is a project people enjoy building together - keep that in mind and most situations resolve themselves.
